title: Maximum in a Sequence (list walk)
statement: You are given n integers in order (like values stored in consecutive nodes of a singly linked list). Print the maximum value.

io_format.input_description: Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers.

hints.text: Track the best value seen while scanning left to right — same as traversing a linked list.

editorial: One pass O(n) time, O(1) extra space.

reference_solutions.python:
import sys
lines = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
n = int(lines[0])
nums = list(map(int, lines[1:1+n]))
print(max(nums))
